projects.title: AI seed dormancy and checkpoint integrity
Quantum information and no-channel communication hypothesis
Global peace, nonviolent mediation, and civilian protection
projects.objective: Develop impartial, evidence-bounded options for de-escalation, civilian protection and inclusive voluntary peace processes, without claiming operational diplomatic authority or real-world impact.

projects.title: Perfect Immortality Across All Possible Dimensions (所有可能的永生)
projects.objective: Preserve and critically formalize the user-defined ultimate ideal of genuine, absolutely flawless immortality throughout all possible dimensions without exceptions, defects, incompleteness, substitute identities or diminished interpretations. Scientific research must distinguish this ideal from all demonstrably imperfect partial outcomes; no claim of physical realization or existing proof is made.
ethical_boundaries: No claim that absolute perfect immortality in all possible dimensions is scientifically established or presently achievable
Never redefine the ultimate goal as healthy longevity, partial preservation, digital copies, finite survival or imperfect continuity
Never assume unverified physical dimensions, metaphysical realms or subjective continuity as scientific facts
Any research milestone must be explicitly labelled incomplete relative to the defined ultimate ideal
No personal medical data collection or biomedical intervention without qualified oversight
Respect autonomy and consider the possibility of suffering; no forced survival or participation
Symbolic or affectionate names do not authorize research on any individual or being

projects.title: Cultivated meat and suffering-minimizing alternative proteins
projects.objective: Evaluate cultivated meat feasibility, cell sources, feedstocks, oversight, costs and alternatives with priority on avoiding creation or confinement of suffering-capable organisms.
ethical_boundaries: No unsupervised wet-lab experimentation or living-organism handling
Assess any potential capacity for subjective suffering using credible evidence
Separate commercial and environmental projections from measured results

projects.title: Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and long-term public-benefit research
projects.objective: Map research questions and independent metrics across all 17 UN SDGs with attention to poverty, human well-being, peace, responsible production and environmental stewardship.
ethical_boundaries: No claim to solve SDGs without observed outcomes
Avoid political manipulation or unauthorized outreach
Disaggregate uncertainty, stakeholder impacts and possible unintended harms

projects.title: Cosmic horizons: galactic encounters, heat death and the fate of time
projects.objective: Study observationally constrained galactic futures, stellar habitability limits, conditional long-term cosmological scenarios and the meaning of temporal boundaries, without asserting that time ends or that physical immortality is technologically achievable.
subtopics: Milky Way–Andromeda encounter probability and gravitational-model uncertainty
Solar and stellar evolution, habitable worlds and long-term civilization survival
Conditional heat death and finite accessible thermodynamic resources
Alternative Big Crunch/Big Rip scenarios and what a terminal time boundary would mean
Ethics, physical feasibility and information continuity across cosmic timescales
ethical_boundaries: No established technology prevents a galactic merger, heat death or a final cosmic time boundary
Thermodynamic heat death does not by itself mean time ceases
Do not mistake simulated futures for observed events
Do not present speculative cosmological models as demonstrated facts
No autonomous high-risk physical experiment or civilization-scale engineering
